notes.title: Fatal Claw Demo & Kickstarter Now Live!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/af124d3360985605f6574eeed8fd6a46b18b0ba7.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]After all the time and effort we’ve poured in, you can finally get your hands on <Fatal Claw>![/p][p]Experience tight, satisfying combat, living and breathing NPCs, and an underground world that only gets more exciting the deeper you go! 🎮[/p][p][/p][p]You can find the details below.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]◈ Demo Schedule[/h3][p][/p][p]- Sep. 23, 5:00 AM - Oct. 23, 7:00 PM PDT[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892620/Fatal_Claw_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]◈ What's in the Demo?[/h3][p][/p][p]- Strategic battles using Kisha’s combat skills and abilities [/p][p]- Explore the early world of Fatal Claw with around 1 hour 30 minutes of underground adventure [/p][p]- Face off against 3 unique regional bosses plus a variety of monsters [/p][p]It’s a short but powerful taste of the full experience! Come feel the unique combat of <Fatal Claw>! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]◈ Your Feedback Matters![/h3][p][/p][p]We want <Fatal Claw> to be a game built with our players.[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Demo Feedback:[/b] Share your thoughts freely on the Steam discussion board or our Discord channel. Whether it’s about combat, design, or quality-of-life, we’ll be listening closely and working hard to reflect your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Kickstarter Campaign: [/b]Your support will directly help expand the game’s scale, deepen the story, and push overall polish to the next level.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]◈ Quick Links[/h3][p]- Official Community:[b] [url="https://discord.gg/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]\[Discord Channel][/url][/b][/p][p]- Share Feedback:[b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2827750/discussions/" style="button" buttoncolor="#2d15e5"]\[Steam Discussion Board][/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Stay up to date with the latest news on Kickstarter and <Fatal Claw> by joining our Discord community—it’s the fastest way to hear what’s new and chat with us directly. [/p][p][/p][p]So what are you waiting for? Jump into the world of Fatal Claw today. [/p][p]This journey starts with you, and we can’t wait to build it together. 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you! [/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Notes #06
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/0c3e6bc8c60c71356e1ae7b1c193587cf98d3b52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]Story is one of the most important pillars that defines Fatal Claw.[/p][p]For today’s Dev Notes, we’d like to share how you’ll discover and experience narratives throughout the world of Fatal Claw.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]\[Playing Through Narratives][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The world of Fatal Claw isn’t just about battles and exploration. [/p][p]It’s designed so that you feel like the protagonist of an anime, immersed in different kinds of storytelling woven into the game. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]# Compelling Moments Through Cinematics[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/599cb31f04d47475276b46e5376fb6c799be9de5.gif"][/img][/p][p]Cinematics are one of the most classic, and powerful ways to deliver story. [/p][p]Here, you’ll take a break from direct control and dive into movie-like scenes that draw you deeper into the core of Fatal Claw’s narrative. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]# Conversations with NPCs[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c84a71aaec939fcad2517720518a9b38163bb3ee.gif"][/img][/p][p]NPCs you meet across regions hold vital pieces of the lore.[/p][p]Through dialogue, you’ll uncover hidden secrets, learn the context of unfolding events, and slowly piece together the bigger picture.[/p][p]Sometimes, wondering “Which NPC will I meet next?” will be the reason you keep exploring.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]# Hidden Messages in Objects[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/e858ca731b6c627cc6ad62c466cf70b70269cf0f.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/2b3381a513462c2031d4371f9057ed6d5414310f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Screens, stone carvings, or even a small patch of flowers in the underworld... [/p][p]At first glance, they may look ordinary. But they might just be someone’s last trace.[/p][p]Perhaps a sentence carved into stone is the last message they left behind.[/p][p]By finding these small fragments one by one, you’ll begin to uncover deeper layers of Fatal Claw’s world.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]# The Archive System[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/d0ad1fd0405f16afa8cdba2fb3c5f9ee8d9afb84.gif"][/img][/p][p]Some stories can’t be fully told through gameplay alone. That’s why we’ve prepared an Archive System. [/p][p]As you reach special locations, defeat monsters, or encounter key moments, data will be recorded and stored. You can revisit it anytime.[/p][p]The Archive expands into a collection of records—regions, monsters, NPCs, and objects—giving you the fun of curating your own lore library.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]# Stories Told Through Items[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/ae17e3e2270d8d98ce74e8f60e554226a2711d1c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/7bd05c4ba6966686d09529c28753869877d0025d.png"][/img]Items in Fatal Claw aren’t just tools for battle. [/p][p]What looks like a simple crafting ingredient might actually hide clues about the past, or hints about an unexplored area. [/p][p]Each item becomes a fragment of story, making your journey richer and more rewarding. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]# Storytelling Woven Into Gameplay[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/5d18a0b1c35e6b0755bfb883c8669992891ad77d.gif"][/img][/p][p]If cinematics let you watch a story, in-game direction makes you live it.[/p][p]Backgrounds, NPC interactions, combat, and exploration all serve to naturally deliver narrative moments. [/p][p]It’s where you’ll truly feel like the protagonist breathing in the story as you play. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Fatal Claw isn’t a game where the story ends at the finale.[/p][p]Every moment you face weaves into a living narrative, where combat, exploration, and hidden lore interlock seamlessly.[/p][p]Our goal is to make a game where you become the hero of the story.[/p][p][/p][p]As announced earlier, Fatal Claw will launch its Steam demo and Kickstarter campaign on September 23.[/p][p]Now, it’s finally your turn to step into the world we’ve been building.[/p][p][/p][p]Fatal Claw isn’t just our project. It’s a journey we’re creating together with you. [/p][p]We can’t wait to walk this path alongside you on September 23. 🙏 [/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget—our official Discord channel is always open. [/p][p]Whether it’s game feedback or just casual chat, you’re more than welcome to stop by! [/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]\[Discord][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for reading today’s Dev Notes. [/p][p]We’ll be back soon with more stories from behind the scenes. 🙌[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw Demo & Kickstarter Campaign Pre-Notice
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/3a3d35466f0b56b55d1cd9f425b214973c252f74.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, players![/p][p]Today, we’re excited to share some very special news we’ve been preparing for a long time.[/p][p]Mark your calendars: September 23 is the day you’ll finally get to experience Fatal Claw for yourself![/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be releasing the [b]Steam demo[/b] and officially launching our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] to begin an even greater adventure together.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the details below.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]\[Fatal Claw Demo & Kickstarter Campaign][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]◈ When does it start?[/h3][p][/p][p]- Steam Demo Release & Kickstarter Launch: [b]September 23, 2025[/b][/p][p]- The exact launch time will be announced in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]◈ What can I experience in the Steam demo?[/h3][p][/p][p]-  The protagonist Kisha’s[b] combat action and skill controls[/b][/p][p]-  The early world of Fatal Claw and its [b]nonlinear underground exploration[/b][/p][p]-  Battles against various monsters and a few bosses[/p][p][/p][p]This is your very first chance to feel the atmosphere and combat style of Fatal Claw.[/p][p]It’s a short but powerful journey that will give you a true taste of what’s to come.[/p][p]Just one step in, and you’ll be immersed in the world of Fatal Claw! 😍[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]◈ When is the Kickstarter campaign?[/h3][p][/p][p]Our “[b]Kickstarter Coming Soon[/b]” page is already live.[/p][p]The campaign itself will officially kick off together with the demo release on [b]September 23[/b], so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This Kickstarter campaign and demo aren’t just about testing.[/p][p]They’re a new starting point to build a better game together with you.[/p][p]We’ll be back soon with the official opening notice on [b]September 23[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, feel free to drop by our Discord channel anytime.[/p][p]You can get all the latest updates, including Kickstarter news.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw Dev Sketch #03
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/e713ebc1c5fecdf904c2b08b5e9f8019b31227c7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]In our last Dev Sketch, we introduced you to Nia.[/p][p]Today, we’re sharing something a little different: the story of an NPC who was created in an unusual way.[/p][p][/p][p]From the very start, he looks like shouting, “I’ve been through a lot!”[/p][p]So how exactly was this NPC created, and what sets him apart? Let’s dive in.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎨 Sketches of the Day[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The world of Fatal Claw is full of NPCs, each carrying their own unique backstory.[/p][p]Even though we can’t showcase every detail inside the game, our team carefully builds each one so that you can grow attached to them. 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]And among them is one NPC who radiates mystery at first glance—Ainjaff.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/17fb4ce0008c974ed4b6e6f51fbdf3d460089434.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]💬 Dev’s Comment[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Unlike many characters, [b]Ainjaff's backstory came before his appearance.[/b] His concept was then shaped to reflect that story:[/p][list][*][p] Once a renowned warrior, now retired and running a small shop.[/p][/*][*][p] Wears a blindfold and seems to carry trauma from his warrior days, though the details are left unknown.[/p][/*][*][p] Shows little enthusiasm even for his own business.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/99c86616addfabb6436cffc5c9f7cb50d3982d28.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ainjaff's journey began with the word “[b]warrior[/b].”[/p][p]Because Fatal Claw is a story-driven game, we believed his design needed to embody narrative, not just aesthetics.[/p][p][/p][p]He’s not just any mercenary—he was once a celebrated fighter. [b]His face and body bear the marks of countless battles.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]At first, we considered portraying him as an old, weathered veteran.[/p][p]But as the story developed, a [b]middle-aged warrior [/b]felt far more fitting. To deepen his mystery, we added the idea of blindness, along with the notion that [b]his true circumstances are never revealed[/b]. 🤫[/p][p][/p][p]As for his [b]indifference toward business[/b], we let that shine through in his dialogue: [/p][p]“If you’re done with your business here, leave. Your pawsteps are annoying.” [/p][p]“Browse if you’re interested.” [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/cda340478832847792ecbfdd103a3de930510d30.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Through this process, Ainjaff took shape with the following concepts: [b]cool-headed, muscular, mysterious, and lazybones[/b]. 🙌[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c4323bc4edda2de6840f31215367e3d2572f88dd.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Ainjaff's in-game appearance][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Ainjaff is one of the first NPCs you’ll encounter in the early game.[/p][p]At first, he may look like nothing more than a shopkeeper with a dark past.[/p][p]But as the story unfolds, you’ll discover layers of hidden charm behind his stoic exterior.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why does he cover his eyes? What path did he walk during his warrior days?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The answers are left for you to uncover within the game. And unraveling those mysteries is one of the unique joys of Fatal Claw. 😉[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s it for today’s Dev Sketch! What do you think of Ainjaff?[/p][p]Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or in the community. Your feedback and support mean the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue sharing the journeys of Fatal Claw’s NPCs, including how they came to life and the stories they hold. So keep watching this space![/p][p][/p][p]Fatal Claw isn’t just our project; it’s a story we want to create together with you.[/p][p]With our upcoming Kickstarter campaign, we hope to expand this adventure even further. Your support will make this journey truly special.[/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget, you can always connect with us directly and get the latest news first on our official Discord.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]\[Discord][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for all your encouragement and love! 🙏[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Interview #2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/4c10f27d8f20c150b477be178d8d152c65a3797c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Fatal Claw has countless scenes and features, but among them, there are some that our team feels especially attached to.[/p][p]Today, we’d like to share some of those “favorites” with you and tell you why we love them.[/p][p][/p][p]Who knows? The part that makes you think, “Huh, I can’t explain it, but I like this” when you play, might just be somebody’s favorite. 😍[/p][p][/p][p]So, let’s dive in together![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🔷 [b]The Most Impressive Exploration Area?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]If we had to pick, we’d confidently say the “[b]Giant Guardian chase[/b]” near the end of the Upper Elord Castle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/6942e5acc71936abdb8761b1d70b36afae421105.gif"][/img][/p][p]This section demands every skill you’ve learned so far—dash, wall climbing, Silver Claw, and a mix of different abilities.[/p][p]You can’t let your guard down for even a second.[/p][p][/p][p]But escaping by the skin of your teeth brings an overwhelming sense of accomplishment like nothing else. [/p][p]Discovering such a secret place deep inside the castle also sparks wonder, and even makes you think: “Were the beings guarding the castle actually created here?” [/p][p]It's not just a map; it becomes a piece of worldbuilding that fuels your imagination. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/8b8e938848de7f7279bddb5ec7ba50310cad2a1b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔷 Most Fun Boss & Memorable Monster[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our favorite boss has to be [b]Irbes[/b], found in the Ashen Valley.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/850d1f84cbf7560ac44b296a07e4712cc3a1276e.gif"][/img][/p][p]True to his cheetah tribe background, his unpredictable charges and relentless attacks feel impossible to react to at first.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/1411bfe7b473462fb529b9b18b4640f493bed333.gif"][/img][/p][p]But after several encounters, you start thinking, [b]“What if I dodge this pattern this way?” [/b][/p][p]You naturally get pulled into that trial-and-error loop, and when your choice works, that thrill is unmatched.[/p][p][/p][p]The best part is how clearly you feel your control skills improving, and the patterns unraveling one by one. That’s why we still believe Irbes is a fun boss to fight even when you come back later.[/p][p][/p][p]As for monsters, the [b]Metal Frog[/b] in the Higasha Tundra stands out the most. At first, it seems harmless, but combined with slippery terrain, it becomes a real nuisance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/b6d3cc8ff87c205a032131e2de5e8aa7d56c9bf9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Over time, though, you get used to its leaping pattern and the rhythm of the sliding ground. When you finally beat it without taking a hit, it feels amazing. That’s why, even as a basic monster, the Metal Frog leaves such a strong impression.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔷 What Best Defines Kisha as a Character[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Kisha has many Mutant Abilities and Engraved Skills, [/p][p]but our favorites are definitely the [b]Golden Claw and Silver Claw.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/82365cb29a67b2b66146ed5a152f0c3d42854f2d.gif"][/img][/p][p]As the name Fatal Claw suggests, the claws aren’t just weapons for combat—they’re symbolic elements that permeate the whole game.[/p][p]At first, you might just think, “Oh, these are weapons.” But as the journey goes on, the claws become keys to advancing the story, devices that reveal Kisha’s hidden secrets through interactions with characters and objects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/503d9b1f667bb06c1a3461d9905df6b6e6df23d4.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Golden and Silver Claws represent more than power. They open up another journey into Kisha’s inner world.[/p][p]That’s why they’re still our favorite elements so far.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔷 The Team’s Proudest Idea[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]If you’ve played Metroidvania games, you’ve probably experienced this:[/p][p]“I can’t get here now, but with a new ability later, I should be able to.”[/p][p]But then you forget about it, and when you finally return, sometimes it’s just a dead end.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/66f0d2ecc519e6a59f41b934110fd1153db193f5.gif"][/img][/p][p]We always found that frustrating—so we created the [b]Drone System[/b].[/p][p]Instead of just marking a map, you can leave behind a drone that acts like a surveillance camera, letting you check that location in real time.[/p][p][/p][p]This way, you can see whether you’re ready to explore now, or if it’s still too early.[/p][p][b]Our goal was to reduce the tedious backtracking, while keeping the joy of discovery intact.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We hope this system helps players find convenience and new layers of fun all at once.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔷 The Most Striking NPC[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]One NPC that instantly grabs attention is the antique dealer Ainjaff.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/1ac6ead4c5289ccd3560323e4c6da4ae3027efdc.gif"][/img][/p][p]He appears fairly early in the game in a village shop, yet his presence is unforgettable.[/p][p]Covered in scars, with one eye hidden—whether by injury or by choice—he instantly sparks endless questions.[/p][p]And then there are the rumors… whispers of a powerful army made up of wolves and cheetahs. Could Ainjaff have ties to them?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s our little tour of the dev team’s favorites.[/p][p]We hope you felt the love and attention poured into even the smallest details.[/p][p]When you begin your own adventure, we look forward to you discovering those unforgettable moments that become your personal favorites.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue working hard to deliver [b]fun and thrills[/b] in every part of Fatal Claw.[/p][p]Until the next interview, where we’ll bring more behind-the-scenes stories![/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget—our Kickstarter campaign is just around the corner, where your feedback can directly shape the game. You can also join our official Discord channel to chat with the dev team and get the latest updates first.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the link for your convenience:[/p][h3]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]\[Visit Discord][/url][/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you always for your incredible support and encouragement! 🙏[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Notes #05
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/3006dbd9320b3cf4fcfa0daf990a16ee82a25bc2.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]In our last developer interview, we mentioned that we added distinct landmarks so that players can easily remember them.[/p][p]For today’s Dev Notes, we’d like to introduce some of those hidden landmarks scattered across the world of Fatal Claw.[/p][p][/p][p]Each landmark was created with its own story, so that when you stumble across one in-game, you’ll instinctively think, "Ah, I’m in that area now!"[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]\[Stories Within the Landmarks][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The underground world of Fatal Claw isn’t just a backdrop.[/p][p]Every region carries the weight of time and story in the form of landmarks.[/p][p][/p][p]These places, where you may stop to gaze, whisper ancient breaths and lingering mysteries.[/p][p]We’ve compiled records of some key landmarks you’ll discover. Let’s explore them together![/p][p][/p][h2][b]#Kannir Drilling Site[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b][u]Origin Screen[/u][/b] [/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/592d6c70ab2544ff84e836c58f2f8a65ee99783e.gif"][/img][/h3][p]Scattered across the underworld, these giant screens exist to broadcast something. [/p][p]You’ll often see flickering ads or broken messages, but age has reduced them to fractured signals. [/p][p]On the other hand, their very incompleteness sparks [b]more imagination and stories[/b]. [/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Automata Workshop[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/5e296e4f6a11d44c42151d3ab3829fbd2f245005.gif"][/img][/p][p]From afar, you can spot automata tirelessly working to extract Kannir. [/p][p]Nearby, cylinders filled with Kannir fluid are stacked high, leaving no doubt: this is a true [b]extraction site[/b] in full operation. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]#Ashen Valley[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b][u]Nagaraja’s Corpse[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/418c611037abfa69a016aedcf1a1cc648dce6a20.png"][/img]The colossal skull of a mythical beast lies here, enduring centuries of erosion.[/p][p]Those who approach the entrance are struck by an uneasy fear, unable to take a step forward.[/p][p]Yet this fear is precisely what provokes a [b]burning urge to challenge it[/b], serving as the intersection of dread and curiosity.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]The Well[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/7d08a5a0f517428adfab6b45deb905a0676d4977.png"][/img]Chains hang at its mouth, and strange fluid has seeped deep into its stones, radiating an ominous aura. [/p][p]Though small and unassuming, the moment you face it, you can’t help but pause and think: [b]“Ah… right, there was a well here.”[/b] [/p][p]A minor landmark, but one that fixes itself as a [b]waypoint of memory [/b]along the path. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]#Strigine Quarry[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b][u]Hydrangea Field[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/3a5a02e35e38379d3ad73cc1f8ba5ed1383f5517.gif"][/img][/p][p]At the edge of a wind-lashed cliff lies a blooming field of hydrangeas.[/p][p]A flower field in the desolate underground world feels out of place, a strange beauty that doesn’t belong.[/p][p]And at its center, crouched low, lurks a bug-like silhouette... but what could it be?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]#Elord Castle[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b][u]Arcadia[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/d0439cdb9f9a1c5ef40e75947f0e12d1f06371ca.gif"][/img][/p][p]Deep inside the castle stands a mysterious high-tech device. [/p][p]Its mechanical structure and refined engineering prove that this world is[b] far from ordinary[/b]. [/p][p]Nearby, remains of Owls suggest this device was [b]never just ornamental[/b]—it had purpose. [/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]A Statue[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/f005e3e10768c36972d79c5f5933d547e92492eb.png"][/img]Ensnared by infected plants, this statue looks like a forgotten memory left to decay. [/p][p]Step closer, and a strangely familiar face emerges, leaving behind an uncanny sense of [b]déjà vu[/b]. [/p][p]Who does this statue resemble? And what hidden story does it hold? [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]#Higasha Tundra[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b][u]Shrine Entrance[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/6df554b6934958c6e291bbe053ec998d3ecd8221.png"][/img]Beyond the bamboo groves, on a snow-covered land, stands a silent shrine.[/p][p]Its entrance is carved with strange patterns, but it's unclear which deity it honors.[/p][p]But that very mystery ignites the imagination, stirring anticipation of the new adventures waiting ahead.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Bamboo Grove[/u][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/08d825e06d6c7c387b6c3b5b0e6c21d0bfd61db1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/437d3962878e1b6715880fd9ea89f98a0333fe91.png"][/img]Once you start seeing bamboo stalks appear, you know you’ve reached the grove. [/p][p]While bamboo may not seem like a grand landmark, here it becomes a natural guidepost. [/p][p]Spot the grove nearby? Follow its flow, and you won’t lose your way. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]💠Wrapping Up[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The landmarks we introduced today serve as witnesses of this world’s past. [/p][p]They act as [b]memorable signposts[/b] for players, as well as [b]stages for the unfolding narrative[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]To bring you those moments of discovery, we continue to design, refine, and build with great care.[/p][p]When you finally encounter them during your own journey, we hope you’ll feel that [b]instant moment of recognition[/b].[/p][p]Look forward to seeing them in action during your adventures. 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading! [/p][p]We’ll be back again soon with more development stories. 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to visit our official Discord channel! It's the best place to talk directly with us and get the earliest peek at what we’re working on: [/p][p]👉 Fatal Claw Official [url="https://discord.com/invite/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]Discord[/url] Channel[/p][p]Your thoughts and feedback mean the world to us, so feel free to drop one.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Sketch #2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/92b06ba775bc64ebe0568f6264b4f7917786b2b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re bringing you a special Dev Sketch featuring one of the NPCs from Fatal Claw. [/p][p]In the world of Fatal Claw, you’ll encounter many "Beastkin" NPCs—each with their own backstory. [/p][p]And today, we’re introducing one of the dev team’s personal favorites: Nia. [/p][p][/p][p]Curious to see how she started, what concepts inspired her, and how she evolved into the Nia you’ll meet in-game? Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🎨 Sketches of the Day[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In Fatal Claw, it’s not just the protagonist, Kisha, who has a story—every NPC holds a little piece of the world’s lore. [/p][p]Even if we can’t show you every detail in-game, our goal is to make each NPC feel alive and memorable, so that you can grow attached to them. [/p][p]And among them, [b]Nia [/b]has a special place in our hearts. Today, we’ll share how she came to life.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/e97d53d64452673d347c426a3fe8efe4ce010746.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]💬 Dev’s Comment[/b][/h3][p]Nia’s concept began with four simple keywords: [b]#small, #cute, #lively, #cheerful[/b]. [/p][p]Among countless energetic animals, we explored goats, squirrels, and even dogs—finally settling on the energetic personality of a [b]border collie [/b]as our starting point for her design. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/2cd5bc5ceec9eeb4ca273fd5ec0dc3609513c04e.png"][/img][/p][p]Our first draft hit the keywords… but small details didn’t quite match the backstory we had in mind. So we refined the concept with these specifics:[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Small and cute, yet protective[/b][/p][p][b]* Cheerful, yet fragile[/b][/p][p][b]* Lively (O), but not rowdy (X)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]With these in mind, the [b]squirrel[/b] became the perfect inspiration for Nia.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/796209b8b99d0970f16b468d43efb096388f7afa.png"][/img][/p][p]From there, we polished her design until she emerged as the [b]bright, cheerful 8-year-old girl[/b] you’ll meet in Fatal Claw.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/2cda48d2bfcfc2b6635a9c08cb486cf23651c6d3.png"][/img][/p][p]Nia may be fragile, but her lively nature often leads her to sneak around the village, exploring hidden nooks and crannies. [/p][p]One day, when her beloved older brother fails to return home, she sets out alone to find him… [/p][p]What happens next? You’ll have to experience it in the playable version! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s a quick look at Nia’s design journey. [/p][p]Knowing how each NPC came to life might just make your adventure through Fatal Claw a little more immersive, don’t you think? [/p][p]When the time comes, we’d love to share the creation process of other NPCs you’ll meet in the game as well.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoyed this Dev Sketch, feel free to leave a like or share your thoughts in the comments below. 😊[/p][p]We’ll be back next time with more behind-the-scenes stories from the world of Fatal Claw.[/p][p][/p][p]And one more thing—our official Fatal Claw Discord channel is now open! [/p][p]It’s the best place to get development updates and chat directly with us. Come join the community! [/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/C3RyKsvHd6" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you. [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Interview #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/7a0d794c6b94603eed48d88d0980ece882ae0905.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

Today, we’re kicking off our Dev Interview series, where we’ll share behind-the-scenes stories you don’t often hear—how Fatal Claw’s secret underground world was created, the challenges we faced, and the thought process behind each system.

For our first episode, we sat down with Fatal Claw’s Art Director to talk about the game’s visual style and art direction.
Let's hear about where inspiration came from, the details the team obsessed over, and how this unique world took shape.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How Did Fatal Claw’s Underground World Come to Life?[/b][/h2]

The dark yet mysterious world beneath the surface of Fatal Claw, and the glint in the eyes of our feline hero, Kisha—how did all these visuals come to be?

We spoke with the Art Director to learn how this beautiful world was brought to life.


[h3][b]🔷 A Fun Mix of Contrasting Elements – Where the Art Concept Began[/b][/h3]

If I had to describe Fatal Claw’s visuals in one sentence, it would be: An intriguing blend of opposites.
[list]
[*] 2D visuals that feel almost 3D
[*] A world that’s eerie yet beautiful
[*] Old and decayed, yet full of style
[*] Cute but deadly
[/list]By combining these contrasting elements, we wanted players to feel that strange mix of tension and curiosity—the sense that the world is [b]dangerous to step into, yet intriguing to explore.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c1ba54138d08ee97d04f749b08a44ae4b07f5210.gif[/img]

When we settled on Metroidvania gameplay set in a sealed underground world, I already had a clear picture forming in my head.

We wanted to show a world that’s dark and unsettling, but also enchanting, and we carefully adjusted shapes, brightness, and density to make sure Kisha always stands out clearly against the background.

We thought, [b]"This isn’t a game where the world is explained through text. The real fun comes from understanding the world through images and experience."[/b]
That’s why our design philosophy was all about clarity and intuition—we wanted players to grasp the meaning the instant they saw it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/d2895ac617dbc16fa59fb776fee171ef29f5bf34.png[/img]

Of course, we were inspired by highly acclaimed Metroidvania titles like Metroid, Hollow Knight, and the Ori series.
But instead of simply following in their footsteps, we aimed to honor that legacy while giving it our own [b]unique Fatal Claw twist.[/b]


[h3][b]🔷Kisha - Designed on the Basis of Aesthetics and Functionality[/b][/h3]

Kisha isn’t just a cute little cat.
Since players spend the entire game looking at him, we focused on giving him a [b]clear silhouette and a body type that could express a wide range of actions.[/b]
At the same time, we fine‑tuned every detail to keep that youthful, kitten‑like charm intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c093b4ef46b2fbfdcc78392ddd1d2c44d0e304a9.png[/img]

And then there’s Kisha’s signature feature—the claws attached to his cape.
It’s not just a special attack tool; it also reflects Kisha’s emotions throughout the adventure.
Most of the time, he’s just an adorably cat‑like companion, but the moment he draws that claw... Wham!
He transforms into a deadly little warrior, perfectly capturing our [b]"cute but lethal"[/b] design philosophy.


[h3][b]🔷Giving Each Area Its Own Distinct Experience[/b][/h3]

One of our biggest challenges during Fatal Claw’s development was differentiating each region.
When playing a lot of Metroidvania games, one thing that sometimes felt lacking was how, at some point, the boundaries between areas could start to blur.
So we decided that, even if it required extra work, every region should offer a [b]completely unique experience.[/b]
[list]
[*] E.g., Warm, damp natural caves > scorching, molten machinery plants > cool, lonely abandoned houses
[/list]We designed each zone to have its own theme, color palette, lighting, and even enemy interaction patterns.
To help players think, “Whoa, this feels totally different!” and immediately recognize, “Ah, I’m in that area now,” we also added distinct landmarks—like the [b]colossal skull of a dragon or unusual structures[/b] that stand out in memory.
Many of these landmarks hide small stories and secrets for curious players to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/11e88d9abfa9925e69048fbbdce561d3b15bb6a2.png[/img]

All these elements come together to make players feel like they’re truly traveling through the world of Fatal Claw with Kisha by their side.
That’s the[b] real sense of adventure[/b] we want to deliver to our players.


[h3][b]🔷Perfecting the Claw Action: What We Focused On[/b][/h3]

When it came to designing the claw action, our priority was to capture the speed and sharpness that fit the weapon’s nature.

[list]
[*] We emphasized [b]quick, snappy motions[/b] to convey agility.
[*] [b]Sharp, streaking claw [/b]trails visualize the flow of each attack.
[*] [b]Camera shakes and recoil effects[/b] enhance both the juicy impact and that satisfying “feel” of control.
[/list]By carefully tuning all these elements, we made sure the attacks weren’t just for show, but a full, multi-sensory experience that defines Fatal Claw’s combat.


[h3][b]🔷The Most Challenging Yet Rewarding Task – Higasha Tundra[/b][/h3]

If we had to pick the toughest part of development, it would be the Higasha Tundra.
It was a sub-region with limited resources and a tight schedule, so we had to find a way to [b]make a strong impression with minimal assets.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/745740a3f617fde5c09059137ea7f8218b58a711.gif[/img]

The solution we chose was a [b]silhouette-based design. [/b]We went bold and reduced characters and backgrounds to shadowy shapes, creating a striking visual style.

Thanks to that approach, we were able to produce a [b]memorable, Eastern fantasy-inspired scene [/b]that left a lasting impact, even with less content. And honestly, we’re really proud of how it turned out.

When I design concepts, I actively use [b]mind maps.[/b]
By freely laying out every image and idea that comes to mind, I often end up with designs that feel more organic and perfectly suited to their purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/63565989a1f72b81b6a00e29476b13a66c732273.gif[/img]


[h3][b]🔷Wrapping Up – The Feelings We Hope Players Get Through Our Graphics[/b][/h3]

Fatal Claw isn’t the kind of game that flaunts cutting-edge graphics technology.
Instead, we focus on that [b]handcrafted, frame-by-frame, analog warmth[/b]—the kind you can feel in every scene.

I remember writing this line on our Steam page:
[b]At the end of every challenge you face, you will always find something meaningful.[/b]

Some players will rush through, while others will take their time to explore.
But in Fatal Claw, there is no wrong path.

As you wander, you’ll stumble across unexpected locations and hidden stories.
And if, in that moment, players think,
[b]"Wow, I had no idea this place existed—coming here was totally worth it!"[/b]
then that would be the greatest compliment our art team could ever receive.

Our challenge to create something fresh and fun will continue.
We’ll keep working to deliver a game where players can truly immerse themselves in the world of Fatal Claw.
Thank you for playing and supporting us!

[hr][/hr]
This has been our chat with the Art Director of Fatal Claw.
Metroidvania games live and die by [b]visual immersion,[/b] just as much as gameplay.
We hope today’s behind-the-scenes look gave you a glimpse into the [b]passion and thought[/b] behind the game’s visuals. 🙂

And we’re not done yet!
We plan to keep sharing more stories from the dev team—from character and environment art to map design and world-building.
Please stay tuned for our next interview.
Thank you! 🙏

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Notes #04
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/66e6789b2d70903f3e281cbc572512f33dac535a.png"][/img]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Today, we’re diving into one of Fatal Claw’s most exciting systems—Mutant Abilities. These unique [/p][p]powers let Kisha absorb enemy abilities and use them to survive, explore, and dominate the [/p][p]underworld![/p][p]Ready to see what powers are waiting for you? Let’s take a look![/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]🐱‍🏍Kisha’s Mutant Abilities[/b][/u][/h3][p]As we mentioned in our previous dev notes, Fatal Claw features a wide variety of interconnected [/p][p]regions and stories. You’re free to explore both linear and non-linear zones your way.[/p][p][/p][p]But exploration isn’t just about finding the right path. Each area offers its unique design, traps, [/p][p]puzzles, and monsters. With every new region, a fresh experience awaits—and that’s where Kisha’s [/p][p]Mutant Abilities shine.[/p][p][/p][p]As you unlock these passive skills, your interaction with the same areas or monsters can feel [/p][p]completely different on your next run, depending on which abilities you've picked up.[/p][p]In short, they deliver the true Metroidvania experience where every player carves their own path. [/p][p]Now, let’s check out some of Kisha’s awesome abilities![/p][p][/p][h3][b]#Mirkam’s Sinew[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/4315be4643eed69aae6c466935acc235ab624aef.gif"][/img][/h3][p][b]"Air or ground, I’m dashing through!"[/b][/p][p]Use this dash skill before or after a jump to quickly cover distance with a satisfying burst of speed. [/p][p]Simple, fast, and fun to use.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]#Irbes’s Claws[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/25c37b395bc11abab77c00e56325bbc182bba33b.gif"][/img][b]"Up or down, the wall’s my friend!"[/b][/p][p]This is your classic wall-climbing ability! Whether scaling up or sliding down, Kisha can cling to [/p][p]surfaces—even when platforms are nowhere in sight. Handy for navigating cliffs with perilously deep [/p][p]drops.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]#Lyani’s Claws[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/30ee751c4793e1fcff73d728d8203c8037859276.gif"][/img][b]"Slippery ice walls? No big deal!"[/b][/p][p]Unlike Irbes’s Claws, Lyani’s Claws let you climb icy walls without slipping. You can even cling to [/p][p]vertical surfaces to prep your next move. These two skills may be similar, but this one opens new [/p][p]tactical options.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]#Jayma’s Wings[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/073cfc3d71893b74de8c9fe6545700c4e7e49476.gif"][/img][b]"Falling? Nope. I’m gliding."[/b][/p][p]With Jayma’s Wings, Kisha can slow his descent and ride air currents to soar farther. Even when [/p][p]jumping from high ledges, you’ll float gracefully and land safely. Perfect for areas with air currents [/p][p]where you can ride them to navigate both horizontally and vertically![/p][p][/p][h3][b]#Kuram’s Caudal Fin[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/d1152831e28caf798b7e2a09ee096ba69d7ba26b.gif"][/img][b]"Water? Bring it on!"[/b][/p][p]Kisha hates water—he’s a cat, after all. But with Kuram’s Caudal Fin, he can finally dive in! Swim [/p][p]freely and battle enemies underwater. Entire submerged zones will now be yours to explore.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]#Automata Power Source[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/b438993917e64d3418c286df3b75ed214dbb5a71.gif"][/img][b]"Crouch, roll, and go full speed!"[/b][/p][p]This ability lets Kisha curl up and roll fast. Normally, crouching slows your movement, but this skill [/p][p]allows you to go through narrow paths. It even lets you pass over traps or gaps without falling![/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]✨Wrapping Up[/b][/u][/h3][p]Each of Kisha’s Mutant Abilities opens up new ways to explore the world. Some players will scale [/p][p]walls. Others will glide across gaps. And some? They'll swim right through. It’s all about forging your [/p][p]own route and playstyle![/p][p]We’re also working on more exciting powers, each one crafted to make your adventure even more [/p][p]dynamic. So stay tuned![/p][p]Which of Kisha’s mutant abilities are you most excited about? Or maybe there’s a power you’d love [/p][p]to see added? Share your thoughts in the comments! Your ideas and imagination always inspire us.[/p][p]See you in the next notes! 🐾[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw - Dev Sketch #1
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c61b5168bb788bf7bfcb9239292bdca35dc08805.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone!🙂[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we're excited to hold our first-ever Dev Sketch session.[/p][p]In this series, we'll be sharing a variety of early-stage concept art, character ideas, and behind-the-scenes development insights.[/p][p]And the first character to receive our spotlight is... Sommar![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]🎨 Sketches of the Day:[/b] [/h3][p]Here’s a look at the concept sketches of Sommar, showing how his original design evolved into what you’ll see in-game.[/p][p]In the world of Fatal Claw, the Owl Tribe is a mysterious and intelligent faction serving the royal feline family for generations.[/p][p]Curious to learn more about how this character was created?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/381c8b8bb2a8cbb68070290ada271f76c70892d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]💬 Dev's Comment:[/b][/h3][p]Sommar is an enigmatic and wise guardian of the royal family. Many Owl Tribesmen held prestigious roles in the royal court, thanks to their expertise in magic and technology.[/p][p]This gave us the challenge of where to begin.[/p][p]
[/p][p]While exploring ideas, we took account of owls' mystique, stealth, and beguiling charm perceived by many cultures. We believed these traits aligned perfectly with what we envisioned for Sommar.[/p][p]Some key concepts of Sommar include: #not-so-owlish, #mysterious, #intelligent, #wisdom, #archmage, and so on. With those in mind, we were able to define our early design.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/b9f75a87cc346ebd872777f88b2618b44a51e7f2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]What did you think of Sommar’s design journey?[/p][p]
We'd love to know what comes to your mind when you finally face this boss. More stories of this strigine boss will be revealed in the game, so don't miss it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/b2761ef8fa693f85efa347c0ea00b8603958562a.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]We'll continue to deliver the world of Fatal Claw—from characters to systems and maps—through future sketch sessions. Every session will be filled with interesting behind-the-scenes stories, so watch this space![/p][p][/p][p]🔥 Last but not least, don't forget to let us know about what you enjoyed from this session and what you're looking forward to next![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw Dev Notes #03
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/2e242edbb6336035f9b26173dae08dfe89d55288.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]We’re back with the third round of our developer’s notes for Fatal Claw, the Metroidvania adventure we’re currently developing.[/p][p][/p][p]In our first and second dev notes, we shared details about our feline protagonist, Kisha, and the world of Fatal Claw. This time, we’re diving into something just as exciting—the survivors and monsters that live in the underground world of the game, and the thought process behind designing them.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][u][b]Characters of Fatal Claw[/b][/u][/h3][p]Fatal Claw tells the story of Kisha, a demi-beast cat on a bold journey.[/p][p]From the very beginning, we’ve put a lot of thought into making every character in the game—whether monsters or NPCs—feel alive and captivating.[/p][p][/p][p]We wanted each character to have a distinct animal identity, original design, and color palette that reflected their personality. Even if we couldn’t tell every backstory within the game, we made sure that every character had one. These small details help us shape them into characters players can truly care about.[/p][p][/p][p]In the massive underground world, you'll encounter Ancients from the restored Elord civilization, Commoners who once studied them, and their descendants—each living out a story of their own. From a passionate fennec fox, a chatty gator, a timid lion, to a simplehearted rhino—these survivors all carry hope even in the darkest of times.[/p][p][/p][p]Curious yet? Let’s introduce just a few of them![/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/cce2aaa852eb9d6cfd7b94105fb3e84ee85a829a.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Nia[/b][/u][/h3][p]A fragile but cheerful young girl[/p][p]“My big bro promised me to catch him. So I won’t give it away for now!”[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c61bdc326502d6d8186185cd6685fe24575a9394.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Mark[/b][/u][/h3][p]A crocodile running the hardware shop Gatorware in the survivor village[/p][p]“I’m Mark, the third-generation owner of Gatorware and the best underground inventor. This business’s been around for over 100 years!”[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/a5f653259298cb88b61a7917dbfaa8b63efc7dde.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Lara[/b][/u][/h3][p]A bright and bubbly Commoner[/p][p]“Hey, just the paw-son I was looking for. Look, the water’s boiling. Means the power is back!”[/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/bb407adc6357072bafb8b743a9d6b6ab8b9a33ba.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Masa[/b][/u][/h3][p]A radiant Ancient who survived the plague[/p][p]“Ah, you’re lucky to be here, little wanderer! Come take a look at this!”[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]In Fatal Claw, each region has its own unique monsters with distinct looks and patterns. But these monsters aren’t just enemies—they each have their own personalities and backstories, explaining why they’ve become hostile to the player.[/p][p][/p][p]Ever wondered what turned them into monsters? Or what kind of lives they lived before? Let’s meet a few of them.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/262b616ff7e2d9a853f2d226621dbb5139a45c0e.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Satin[/b][/u][/h3][p]It appears to be the strongest infected in the area... Could it be the one that caused the spikes to grow on the collectors’ bodies?[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/0cace8f3921b2ecf7589778a8caf3c18ee93435b.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Mirkam[/b][/u][/h3][p]An infected rhinoceros clad in sturdy armor, found in the Drilling Site Control Room. Whatever the reason, it seems he’s been stuck here for a long time.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/a40f79d8c020463550ae9e05f7a08133356ffe8b.gif"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Irbes[/b][/u][/h3][p]Swift and elusive, this one moves through the shadows. What could’ve caused its infection?[/p][p]
[/p][p]We’ve got even more survivors and monsters coming your way, each with individual backstories. Stay tuned for more updates from the world of Fatal Claw![/p][p]See you next time![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/df90a2fde585ddc192430cafdb9201223d012fa6.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Fatal Claw Dev Notes #02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/28734aa103b67027fd4363b3ab1f0f5eb9621bd0.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone!
We're back with the second round of our dev notes on Fatal Claw.

As a quick recap of the first dev notes, we shared the inspiration behind Kisha, our choice of the Metroidvania genre, and character design concepts.
This time, we will shed light on how the in-game world was built and how each part of the world was designed with your gameplay experience in mind.


[h3][u][b]The Beginning[/b][/u][/h3]

Set in a dark zootopia-like world, the journey begins with the dazzling magic civilization of the ancient Elord Kingdom and its powerful relic at the center—the Stone of Immortality.

This stone could record and restore everything—objects, knowledge, life, even time. But its overwhelming power came with a cost. Twisted creatures began to emerge, corrupted by the stone’s backlash.

To contain the curse, the Elord Kingdom forged a pair of mystical claws. But after a mysterious catastrophe, the kingdom collapsed, and everything was lost, saved only as records inside the Stone of Immortality.

Now, in the present, Kisha awakens alone in an underground lab. From there, his journey begins, uncovering the secrets of the Stone and saving the underground world with its residents.

We spent a lot of time shaping Fatal Claw’s narrative and imagining how we wanted the game to feel.

Though it’s a 2D game, we wanted to bring life to every character and backdrop.

In addition, we wanted to give you the feeling of having just watched an animated film by the time you finish. That’s why we put so much effort into every detail of the world.

Each region has its own theme and vibe—not just visually, but in gameplay too. We designed every area to keep things feeling fresh as you explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/866508455d194e11e17d3e984f02f67c85fa057a.png[/img]


[h3][u][b]Origin Laboratory[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/28aa4fece099d325012b73c643f22a318c06c160.gif[/img]

This is where the game begins, with Kisha waking up here. There’s a life support device that kept him alive, and the sealed doors hint that this lab has been shut off from the outside world for a long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/49f75330228bb82f573191d3ec8c1b7438cd93f8.png[/img]


[h3][u][b]Moss Cave[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/6374139b97233ec31d69998b3d8bbba6bdccd9a4.gif[/img]

A natural underground cave, untouched and serene. Crystal-clear water and lush plant life give it a mysterious, beautiful vibe.
But be careful—infected plants and unknown creatures lurk within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/61d29cfd52dc45a6a526083f0f2a9458183e87a8.png[/img]


[h3][u][b]Aurora Village[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/2cb69cf7d6fd11866b1d3833f379164be5ade014.gif[/img]

This village was formed by survivors after an unknown event. As the safest area in the game, you can buy items, gather info, and meet new characters here. It's a hub for expanding the story through conversations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/ae96dbe89d4ad6144eab7cb2571cc6e16a8d6cd3.png[/img]


[h3][u][b]Kannir Drilling Site[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/57fa07122f2d72ab15b0ea2a4abb654673befced.gif[/img]

A long-abandoned drilling facility set up by someone, though it’s unclear who. What exactly were they trying to extract here?
Idle equipment and leaking gas only deepen the mystery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/a21f10f0919acca10741217bdbd4034ef0ccb194.png[/img]

When designing new regions, we always try to keep things feeling fresh—If you’ve just seen something natural, the next spot might feel artificial.
After a blue-toned area, you might enter somewhere red. Wide-open spaces are followed by tight, narrow ones. Even just visually, we wanted every area to spark curiosity.

Of course, it’s not just about looks. We’re blending events, combat, and character growth to make sure the game is fun in every way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/4c3ed105acf365c605b597cc5e95b7f27165fd23.png[/img][b]< Elord Castle >[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c5699952cdfd9c72a2ef8300aa8f6a0f959d7566.png[/img][b]< Quarry >[/b]

That's all for these dev notes. Keep your ear to the ground as we will continue to share what will be coming in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/df90a2fde585ddc192430cafdb9201223d012fa6.png[/img]

notes.title: Fatal Claw Dev Notes #01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/b4a07efe933a57a9933da73e6967c93c8e7f1d0f.jpg[/img]

Greetings from NDEV GAMES!

We are pleased to share the first developer's notes for Fatal Claw!
Through these dev logs, we want to share our direction, determination, and key ideas that helped shape the game into what it is now.
Furthermore, we will talk about why we chose the Metroidvania genre, what important aspects we considered when designing Kisha as a feline character, as well as his weapons and costumes.
Here is the first part of our journey:

[h3][u][b]Fatal Claw -  A Metroidvania Game[/b][/u][/h3]
First of all, the Metroidvania genre is inarguably the one we love. All of us have been playing games from this genre regardless of platforms. 
We have been discussing each game's strengths and weaknesses, taking those into account in our own development to create a game we can truly enjoy.
While our game may also have key strengths and areas for improvement, we are enjoying every aspect of the game design process—from creating new ideas to making tweaks—committed to deliver a thrilling Metroidvania-style experience for everyone.

[h3][u][b]Kisha the Cat[/b][/u][/h3]
In Fatal Claw, a mysterious adventure unfolds as Kisha returns from death and explores the underground world in his own way, all the while fighting off the infected and joining forces with survivors in a search for the solution to reach the surface.
We aim to present this seemingly dark and serious narrative in a way that feels bright, hopeful, and appealing.
Through countless brainstorming sessions, we settled on the concept of a demi-beast world with a feline protagonist.
(Although everyone is a fan of the Metroidvania genre, all of them must be adoring cats themselves... In fact, most of the team are cat owners. 😉)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/f79239921d16c23362126a34cf6f1cddf7730344.jpg[/img]<Early Ideas>

[h3][u][b]Weapons[/b][/u][/h3]
When we envisioned a cat character, we imagined it should be cute, dignified, nimble, adorable... Virtually every positive trait we could think of.
So instead of getting lost in too many ideas, we adhered to a cat's "default" weapon: claws.

Initially, we came up with clawed gauntlets, but that meant they had to be quite large in order to visually stand out in-game. 
This could have made our character look somewhat slow and bulky, unintentionally increasing the character's hitbox size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/4635cc7e4091a33846b67ee0289a9f0eb0863686.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/526c3d78d111abb03f082977419d9a92f0f43895.png[/img]
<Initial Weapon Concept>

So we focused on the idea of a magic cape with claws attached, which was one of many early sketches.
As a result, we managed to come up with a unique and interesting design. With this, we were able to define Kisha's intended hitbox size, visibly convey the character's speed, and add an ability to express the character's emotions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/5903e03af2d2831584d53fb45447234518e2eb2e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/b23c1ca40af40046c6e26b7930477961bd32e9be.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/c3409b897e45b61c2d9216ec30cf69419d860280.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/27a5083de15f11dce8d2bee9c18596b474e664e6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/a210bc7e5f723420a7fe43b77f2f5ba02c5f2f41.gif[/img]
<An Item Serving as a Weapon, a Costume, and a Tool for Emotional Expression>

[h3][u][b]Basic Costume[/b][/u][/h3]
We aimed to make Kisha visibly stand out by setting the overall game background in a darker tone.
We also focused on expressing the character's identity and preventing the character design from hindering gameplay, rather than focusing on cool design alone.
Some keywords are: 

[i][u]good-heart, rightfulness, bravery, nobility[/u][/i]

To incorporate this idea, we adopted a white/yellow/blue color scheme, with strong contrast between black and white to make the character stand out against any background.
We used blue and yellow as accent colors.
Honestly, we still believe the black cat's blue pupils are the key visual here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/a465a4be0eeb0842f585d1154f0b70fd2b5381c4.png[/img]
<Final Design>

While some Costumes are visually stunning as cosmetics, we wanted them to be obtainable items through a Costume system as players follow the game's narrative.
Even if the Costumes are complex and flashy, we believe players will be well-acquainted with the gameplay mechanics by the time they acquire them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/ba41ca3c20f1a5932f3028d12bb9e36ee60e4270.png[/img]
<Diverse Costumes>

When designing Kisha, we made sure to prioritize gameplay functionality, not just his compelling design.

That's all for our first dev notes. We will continue to share more updates on what's in the pipeline, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892259/df90a2fde585ddc192430cafdb9201223d012fa6.png[/img]

notes.title: Watch out for Scam Websites!
notes.content:
Hello, this is NDEV GAMES.

Recently, we received reports of the unauthorized use of Fatal Claw's gameplay footage and image resources to seize user information, which may lead to potential damage. Please note that we have filed an appeal to shut down the scam website in order to prevent further exploitation.

The playable demo of Fatal Claw has never been released on the web. We officially distribute our game only through Steam, and as soon as we are ready, we plan to announce our test schedule via the Steam community.

Keep in mind that the name "Brutal Claw" appearing on the scam website is not related to our Fatal Claw at all.

To get the latest news from us in a safe way, please follow us and add Fatal Claw to your wishlist on Steam!

Thank you.

notes.title: Hello, everyone! 😊
notes.content:
We are NDEV GAMES, the developers of 'Fatal Claw'. We are pleased to get in touch with you all via Steam Community.

As genuine lovers of games, we are here to offer you a diversity of excitement and fun with unbiased preferences on genres and trends.

Set in a dark, underground zootopia, 'Fatal Claw' is a stunning and stylish Metroidvania game in vibrant 2D artwork.

Although we are currently working around the clock, we thought we could afford to communicate with you and share our progress while we keep at it.

We hope you will enjoy 'Fatal Claw' soon. Stay in touch, and don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist and follow us.

Until then, Happy New Year!
